🌑 Bad Eden DARKNESS SYSTEM — LIVE AUTOMATION CANON

“Darkness is not evil.
It is pressure with memory.”

1. WHAT DARKNESS IS

Darkness is a faction-level corruption and instability pressure track.
It is stored on faction flags and updated automatically during Advance Turn processing, primarily in response to Radiated territory, purification, and cleanup systems.

Core identity

PropertyLive Canon
DarknessA faction pressure track representing corruption, instability, psychic contamination, and regional collapse risk
Stored Onflags.bbttcc-factions.darkness
Main Automatic DriverOwned hexes with the Radiated condition
Main Automatic ReliefPurification and cleanup of corrupted/radiated territory
Passive DecayNot free-floating; it changes because of territory state, not because time simply passes

2. WHAT AUTOMATICALLY CHANGES DARKNESS RIGHT NOW

A. Owned Radiated territory

Each Advance Turn, the system checks whether a faction owns any hexes marked Radiated.

Territory stateDarkness change
Owns 1 or more Radiated hexes+1 Darkness
Owns 0 Radiated hexes-1 Darkness

Darkness in this wrapper is capped at 10.

B. Purified cleanup

When Purified hex cleanup runs, the system:

  • removes Radiated
  • removes Contaminated
  • zeros out hex radiation mods
  • reduces faction Darkness by 2 for factions whose cleansed hexes were processed.

C. Purified aura

Purified hexes also cleanse nearby hexes, removing Radiated and Contaminated from neighbors.
This does not directly subtract Darkness on its own, but it helps remove the conditions that cause future Darkness growth.

3. LIVE DARKNESS THRESHOLD TABLE

These thresholds are now partially automated.
They do not yet appear to execute a full catastrophe engine from this file alone, but they do generate automated GM-facing narrative warnings during Advance Turn.

DarknessBandLive automatic effectMal translation
0ClearNo Darkness pressure; Morale may recover toward baseline“The air is breathable again.”
1–3StrainedMorale pressure begins“The shadow has your address.”
4–6ShadowedGM ping: night terrors, unrest omens“People start sleeping with knives.”
7–9IntrusionGM ping: contamination/intrusion warning“The walls start answering back.”
10CalamityGM ping: regional calamity warning“Now the land remembers how to hate.”

Important note

The threshold system currently posts automated narrative pings to GMs.
It does not fully prove, from these files alone, that every calamity payload is auto-applied to the world state. The warning layer is live; full disaster mutation may still be partial or live elsewhere.

4. LIVE MECHANICAL CONSEQUENCES OF DARKNESS

Morale pressure

Darkness actively harms faction Morale every Advance Turn.

Darkness stateMorale effect
Darkness >= 1Morale -1
Darkness == 0 and Morale below 50Morale +1 toward 50

This is one of the clearest live mechanical consequences in the current code.

Leyline purity corruption

Darkness also affects Leyline purity drift.

Darkness stateLeyline purity effect
Darkness >= 7Purity drifts downward by 1
Darkness <= 3 on Sephirothic hexesPurity may recover by 1

So Darkness is already interacting with the world’s metaphysical stability, not just morale.

5. RELATIONSHIP TO RADIATION

Darkness and Radiation are connected, but they are not identical.

Radiation is primarily:

  • a hex condition
  • an actor/faction RP track
  • a territory contamination system
  • a travel and environmental hazard system.

Darkness is primarily:

  • a faction corruption/pressure track
  • fed by territorial contamination
  • expressed through morale damage, threshold warnings, and purity drift.

The actual live loop

Radiation systems mark territory Radiated
→ factions that own Radiated hexes gain Darkness each turn
→ Darkness pressures Morale and corrupts Leyline purity
→ Purification removes Radiated/Contaminated states
→ Darkness falls again if the territory is cleaned

That is the live systemic chain.

6. WHAT THE RADIATION OVERLAY ACTUALLY IS

The “green screen effect” memory was real, but it belongs to the Radiation Zone overlay, not Darkness itself.

Live radiation visuals

Scene-level radiation zones can apply a tinted overlay to the active scene, with a toxic green default tint and intensity-based alpha.

That means:

  • there is a dramatic greenish environmental overlay in the current system
  • it is tied to Radiation Zone intensity
  • it is not, from the uploaded files, a Darkness-specific overlay.

7. WHAT IS PERSISTENT ON HEXES

Hexes can carry persistent condition flags under:

flags["bbttcc-territory"].conditions

Relevant conditions confirmed in the uploaded systems include:

ConditionMeaning
RadiatedHex is actively contaminated and can feed Darkness / RP systems
ContaminatedCorrupted environmental state
PurifiedHex has been cleansed and can participate in cleanup effects
CorruptedUsed by destructive/corruption request processing

These conditions are persistent and can be synced from queued turn effects.

8. TRUSTWORTHY CANON: WHAT IS FULLY LIVE VS WHAT IS STILL MOSTLY GUIDANCE

Fully live in code now

FeatureStatus
Darkness stored on factionsLive
Darkness rises from owned Radiated hexesLive
Darkness falls when Radiated ownership is goneLive
Darkness cap of 10 in wrapperLive
Threshold detection and GM pingsLive
Morale penalty from DarknessLive
Purified cleanup reduces DarknessLive
Purified aura clears neighboring corruption/radiationLive
Leyline purity drift from DarknessLive

Not fully proven from uploaded files alone

FeatureStatus
Full automatic regional catastrophe payload at threshold 10Not fully proven here
Darkness-specific fullscreen visual overlayNot found in uploaded files
Any separate “global world Darkness collapse engine” outside the turn wrapperNot found in uploaded files

9. PLAYER-FACING SUMMARY

Darkness does not just mean “bad vibes.”
It means your land is staying sick long enough to start changing you.

If your faction holds Radiated territory, Darkness rises.
If Darkness rises, Morale falls.
If it rises far enough, the game starts warning the GM that the region is sliding into unrest, intrusion, and calamity.
Purification is not flavor text. It is how you stop the land from becoming a machine that manufactures despair.

10. MAL SUMMARY

“Radiation is the wound.
Darkness is what happens when you keep living in it.
Clean the land, or the land starts cleaning out pieces of you.”

☢️ Bad Eden RADIATION SYSTEM — LIVE AUTOMATION CANON

“Radiation is not just fallout.
It is the world remembering the wrong shape.”

1. WHAT RADIATION IS

Radiation is a persistent contamination and exposure system that operates at both the territory level and the actor/faction level.

It exists in three linked layers:

LayerLive form
Actor / Faction exposureRadiation Points (RP) stored on actors
Hex contaminationRadiated, Contaminated, and Purified conditions plus mods.radiation
Scene falloutRadiation Zone intensity and overlay on the active scene

These layers interact through travel, turn advancement, mutation triggers, and cleanup systems.

2. WHERE RADIATION LIVES

Actor / faction RP

Radiation exposure is stored on actors as:

flags["bbttcc-radiation"].rp

The Radiation API exposes:

  • get(actor)
  • set(actor, value)
  • add(actor, amount)
  • levelFor(value)

Hex contamination

Hex conditions live on territory hexes under:

flags["bbttcc-territory"].conditions

Common live conditions:

  • Radiated
  • Contaminated
  • Purified
  • Corrupted

Hexes may also carry numeric contamination under:

flags["bbttcc-territory"].mods.radiation

Scene radiation weather

Scenes can store a zone config under:

flags["bbttcc-radiation"].zone

with intensity:

  • none
  • low
  • moderate
  • high
  • storm

3. RADIATION LEVEL BANDS

The Radiation API defines these live RP bands:

RPBand
0–10Safe
11–25Low
26–50Moderate
51–75High
76–95Extreme
96+Lethal

When an actor crosses from one band to another, the system posts a notification.

4. WHAT AUTOMATICALLY ADDS RADIATION

A. Travel into contaminated terrain

When a faction actor travels into a hazardous hex, RP is added automatically.

Travel sourceRP gained
Terrain = wasteland or radiation+1
Hex condition Radiated+1
Hex condition Contaminated+1
mods.radiation+that value

This is applied on bbttcc:afterTravel. A GM whisper is also generated summarizing the exposure source.

B. Scene fallout zones during travel

Radiation zones add ambient fallout on travel into the scene.

Zone intensityTravel RP
none0
low50% chance of +1
moderate+1
high+2
storm+3

This stacks as ambient fallout and is also GM-whispered.

C. Advance Turn environmental exposure

On bbttcc:advanceTurn:end, tokens in the active scene may gain or lose RP depending on their environment.

Faction actors

Faction actors receive:

  • full Zone exposure
  • full Hex exposure.

PCs / NPCs

Characters and NPCs receive:

  • half Zone exposure, floored
  • half Hex exposure, floored
  • -1 RP if they are in a fully safe area.

That means player characters can slowly detox in safe territory, while factions are modeled more as strategic entities tied to environmental conditions.

5. WHAT AUTOMATICALLY REMOVES OR REDUCES RADIATION

A. Radiation decay on hexes

During the territory Advance Turn wrapper, hex radiation decays automatically.

Hex stateEffect
mods.radiation > 0radiation reduced by 1
if it reaches 0 and hex is RadiatedRadiated condition is removed

So environmental contamination does not remain static forever unless it is being actively refreshed or spread.

B. Radiation spread

If a hex still has significant radiation after decay:

ConditionEffect
mods.radiation >= 3may spread to nearby hexes
Spread chance25% per nearby hex
Resultnearby hex gains Radiated, and mods.radiation is set to at least 1

This creates a live contamination ecology rather than a one-off mark.

C. Purified cleanup

Purified hexes automatically:

  • remove Radiated
  • remove Contaminated
  • zero out mods.radiation.

D. Purified cleanup aura

Purified hexes also cleanse nearby hexes, stripping:

  • Radiated
  • Contaminated
  • and zeroing nearby radiation mods.

E. Purified faction bleed-off

Factions benefit directly from Purified territory.

For factions resting in/owning Purified hexes:

  • Radiation is reduced by up to the number of Purified hexes they control
  • capped by current RP.

6. MUTATIONS

Mutations are currently live and narrative, not yet a full mechanical debuff lattice.

Mutation trigger

A mutation event is triggered when an actor goes from:

below 50 RP → 50 or higher RP

When that happens, the system fires:

bbttcc.mutationRoll

The mutation enhancer listens for that hook, generates a mutation entry, stores it on the actor, and whispers the GM.

Mutation storage

Mutations are stored under:

flags["bbttcc-radiation"].mutations

Narrative mutation tiers

The mutation system uses these live tiers:

RP at triggerMutation tier
50–59minor
60–79significant
80–99major
100+cataclysmic

Each tier draws from a narrative table of mutation results.

What mutations do right now

At present, mutations are:

  • recorded on the actor
  • surfaced to GMs
  • shown in the Radiation overlay tab on character sheets.

They are best understood right now as canonized narrative tags with UI support.

7. THE RADIATION OVERLAY

Yes — this is the green environmental effect.

Scene radiation zones can draw a tinted overlay across the active scene.
The default color is toxic green, and alpha increases with intensity.

Live intensity visual mapping

Zone intensityApproximate overlay strength
lowsubtle
moderatestronger
highheavy
stormheaviest

The overlay is scene-wide in the current implementation and is client-toggleable.

This is the visual effect you were remembering.

8. RADIATION AND TURN ADVANCEMENT

Radiation has one of the densest live automation stacks in Bad Eden right now.

Advance Turn radiation stack

On a typical turn cycle, the system can do all of the following:

  1. Decay hex radiation by 1
  2. Remove Radiated if radiation falls to 0
  3. Spread radiation outward from heavily contaminated hexes
  4. Cleanse Purified hexes
  5. Cleanse neighbors of Purified hexes
  6. Reduce faction RP through Purified ownership
  7. Apply per-turn zone + hex exposure to actors in the active scene.

That means Radiation is not a passive note. It is a living territory hazard cycle.

9. HOW RADIATION CONNECTS TO DARKNESS

Radiation and Darkness are separate tracks, but they are coupled.

The live chain

Radiation contamination on hexes can produce Radiated territory.
Factions that own Radiated territory gain Darkness during Advance Turn.
Darkness then produces:

  • Morale pressure
  • threshold warnings
  • Leyline purity corruption.

Practical reading

RadiationDarkness
The wound in the landThe pressure that builds when the wound stays open
Territory / actor contaminationFaction corruption / despair / instability
RP, zones, hex conditionsMorale, thresholds, purity drift

10. WHAT IS FULLY LIVE VS WHAT IS MOSTLY NARRATIVE

Fully live right now

FeatureStatus
RP stored on actorsLive
Radiation bandingLive
Band change notificationsLive
Mutation trigger at 50+ crossingLive
Mutation storage on actorsLive
Travel RP from terrain/conditionsLive
Zone fallout on travelLive
Scene radiation overlayLive
Per-turn actor exposureLive
Hex radiation decayLive
Hex radiation spreadLive
Purified cleanup and auraLive
Faction RP bleed-off from Purified hexesLive

More narrative / light-touch for now

FeatureStatus
Mutation results as full mechanical debuff packagesNot shown in uploaded code
Character-level long-term medical subsystemNot shown in uploaded code
Separate radiation-specific collapse/catastrophe engine beyond zones/hexes/mutationsNot shown in uploaded code

11. PLAYER-FACING SUMMARY

Radiation in Bad Eden is not just “take damage and move on.”
It is an environmental memory system.

You pick it up by:

  • traveling through bad land
  • lingering in poisoned places
  • operating in fallout zones
  • staying where the world is already sick.

It fades when:

  • the land is cleaned
  • Purified territory holds
  • you rest somewhere truly safe
  • your faction does the work of healing the frontier.

Ignore it long enough, and the land starts writing on you.

12. MAL SUMMARY

“Radiation is the stain on the page.
Darkness is what happens when you keep reading from it.
Clean your hexes, or eventually your people start glowing for theological reasons.”
